technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with breakout confirmation and volume spike, but overbought conditions and lack of longer-term trend alignment limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: FDS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 90 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 15) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (oldest 1,736 days) and absent recent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (369.92), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions; 90-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + 15x volume spike + dc20 new high create genuine short-term breakout confirmation with contrarian extreme fear backdrop offering asymmetric risk/reward.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI, StochRSI, Williams %R), price below 200-EMA and 50-SMA, VIX crisis regime (369.92), high credit spreads, zero fundamental support, and 90-day earnings event risk make this a momentum trap in hostile macro conditions.
